- **Install this release to keep getting updates.** nteract moved to a new
  update signing key. Stable 2.11.0 is the bridge: it is the last stable
  release signed with the previous key, and it carries the new one. Later
  releases are signed with the new key only, so an install that skips 2.11.0
  cannot update in the app and needs a fresh download. Nightly made the same
  move on 2026-11-25.
- **Installed Jupyter kernels:** environment selection now lists the Jupyter
  kernels installed on your machine, so a notebook can run on a kernel you
  already manage.
- **Clearer runtime errors:** a failed interpreter probe is reported as such,
  and no longer as a missing `ipykernel`.
- **Signed release checksums:** every release ships a `SHA256SUMS` file signed
  with minisign. The shell installer checks each download against it, and
  `--require-signature` makes the signature check mandatory.
- **macOS shell installer:** the app now installs to `/Applications`, the same
  place the DMG uses, and an older copy in `~/Applications` is removed.
- **APT repository retired:** `apt.runtimed.com` no longer publishes, and its
  signing key is retired. If you added it, remove the source and the keyring:

  ```bash
  sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nteract.list \
    /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nteract-nightly.list \
    /usr/share/keyrings/nteract-keyring.gpg
  sudo apt update
  ```
